cases.name: Candiace "Candy" Person
cases.about: She was described as independent and had a custodial job in the local school system. She was a devout churchgoer and devoted mother.
cases.relationship: Son / stepson / partner's son / child's partner
cases.narrative: Her daughter found her body, nude from the waist down and wrapped in a blanket. Her home's phone cord had been cut.
